title: ctenitis acuta
intro: Ctenitis acuta, commonly known as Mountain Fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and sore throat, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Ctenitis acuta include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its ability to alleviate symptoms and promote recovery. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
